rows.label: tlk45300021_02_msg0001
rows.name:
My older brother serves in the
Superbian Military Engineer Corps.

rows.label: tlk45300021_02_msg0002
rows.name:
It's dangerous work transporting Core
Crystals.

rows.label: tlk45300021_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I could only move to Torigo thanks to
my older brother putting in a word for
me.

rows.label: tlk45300021_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But now the Iira lot showed up
in Torigo... They even escaped
Special Commissioner Meleph.

rows.label: tlk45300021_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Maybe we would've been better
off living a quiet life back
in Superbia after all...
